services.description: List of load-balanced services (farms) to configure. Each service defines a virtual IP, protocol, and backend pool per nftlb(8) documentation.

items.description: A single farm (service) configuration object matching the nftlb JSON format.

name.description: Name of the backend (required by nftlb).

iface.description: Input interface (only required for DSR mode).

oface.description: Output interface (only required for DSR mode).

family.description: Family of the virtual service: ipv4, ipv6, or dual (ipv4 by default).

ether_addr.description: Physical (MAC) address of the backend (required for DSR mode).

virtual_addr.description: IP address for the virtual service (required).

virtual_ports.description: Port list (comma-separated or hyphen-ranged, e.g., 80 or 80-88).

mode.description: Topology mode: snat, dnat, or dsr (required).

proto.description: Protocol: tcp, udp, sctp, or all (tcp by default).

scheduler.description: Scheduler: weight, rr, hash, symhash (round robin by default).

priority.description: Priority for the backend (1 by default).

state.description: State: up, down, or off (up by default).

ip_addr.description: IP address for the backend (required, except for DSR).

weight.description: Weight of the backend (1 by default).
